messages:
ana_mkt: Quick recap  interviewed VantageAI this AM. They gave a short line we can use in the case header: "Redwood made inference costs predictable and materially lower for production workloads." Need legal + comms OK and webinar routing.

Tom_growth: Nice. Paste verbatim and attach the clip. I'll cut a 15s teaser for socials once approved.

ana_mkt: Verbatim: "Redwood made inference costs predictable and materially lower for production workloads, which sped up our release cadence." Audio uploaded to Files.

Dylan_legal: Recommend soften numeric/absolute language. Propose: "significantly reduced per-inference costs while improving predictability". Also need the signed advocacy release and comms approval for edited quote.

Mike_cs: They signed the standard release. I'll ping their comms to confirm the softened wording and get the exact attribution (name + title). They want a link to their public benchmark notebook included. No embargo.

Tom_se: For routing I'll create SFDC campaign + HubSpot form. Fields: email, company, role, use_case, interest_tier, attended_webinar(Y/N), utm params. High-intent (use_case contains "benchmark" or "cost") -> AE queue.

publish-bot: Checklist reminder: signed release, comms approval, SFDC campaign created, assets uploaded, tracking tags present.

ana_mkt: Comms confirmed softened wording and gave attribution: "Ravi Patel, Head of ML, VantageAI". Landing draft updated and release attached. Planning to open registration Mon 09:00 PT, webinar Thu 10:00 PT.

Tom_growth: Great. I'll set up A/B headlines for paid promos. Mike, please schedule a 15m speaker prep call day before.

Mike_cs: Calendar invite sent. Legal sign-off pending final attachment check; will confirm once the release is in the CMS entry.

ana_mkt: Release attached to CMS and quote block set to legal wording. Marking thread resolved. Thanks team :tada:
